requestedProduct: Tnuva 5% plain cottage cheese, standard 250 g tubs
objective: lowest item subtotal plus shipping and mandatory fees for each exact batch

environment.where: GitHub Actions hosted runner (ubuntu, GitHub-hosted IP space)
environment.note: Every fetch below was made from the runner against the store's own public endpoints with curl. No proxy, credential, login, payment, street address, order or access-control bypass was used. Cart ids are deliberately not recorded.

policies: duchan-cottage-ganei-shmuel-home-delivery v1 (home delivery ₪28, no minimum order, free delivery published above ₪599)
runtime.note: For the Ganei Shmuel (גן שמואל) delivery area every exact 4/6/8/10-tub batch is purchasable and ranked with anonymous public cart quotes: ₪53.20/₪65.80/₪78.40/₪91.00. The default Tel Aviv–Yafo locality stays unranked (Tiv Taam ₪300 minimum, Super Yuda ₪150 minimum, Duchan does not deliver there); no total is invented for it.

sources.name: Duchan Ganei Shmuel (דוכן גן שמואל), branch 2175 — the store's only online branch

product.stockEvidence: branch.isActive=true, isVisible=true, isOutOfStock=false — the store's own branch flags, not a price-only scrape
product.purchaseCapEvidence: The product API publishes quantityLimit 999 per line, far above the largest requested batch. Anonymous carts accepted 4/6/8/10-tub lines without a limit warning.

delivery.regionalAreasObserved: The retailer config (https://htmlcache.blob.core.windows.net/html-production-env/r-1420/desktop/multi-true/data.js) lists further areas around the Hadera/Pardes Hanna region (Pardes Hanna-Karkur, Ein Iron/Kfar Pines, Telmi Elazar, Harish, Or Akiva, Zikhron Ya'akov, Caesarea and others) with deliveryMinimumCost ₪250 each; only the local גן שמואל area has no minimum.

minimumOrder.publishedStatement: The store FAQ publishes "האם יש סכום מינימום להזמנה?" — "לא, אבל המשלוח יהיה חינם מעל 599₪" (Is there a minimum order amount? No, but delivery is free above ₪599).
minimumOrder.source: https://htmlcache.blob.core.windows.net/html-production-env/r-1420/desktop/multi-true/data.js (FAQ + banner "משלוחים חינם בקנייה מעל 599 ש''ח", valid until 31.12.2026)

freeThreshold.note: Every requested batch (₪25.20-₪63.00 item) stays below ₪599, so the ₪28 delivery line applies.

delivery.coverage: The local גן שמואל area polygon around the store; the FAQ lists the wider Hadera-region delivery localities, but those areas publish the ₪250 minimum. Coverage outside the published areas is not established.
delivery.robots: https://www.duchan.co.il/robots.txt: Crawl-delay 4; /cart*, /user*, /search* disallowed; the product API and the catalogProduct page are not disallowed. The adapter declares crawlDelayMs 4000.

anonymousCartQuotes.method: Public anonymous cart API: POST /v2/retailers/1420/branches/2175/carts with {"lines":[{"retailerProductId":9469068,"quantity":N,"type":1}]}, then POST /carts/<id>/delivery-line {"areaId":4604,"deliveryTypeIds":[1]}, then PATCH /carts/<id> {"deliveryProduct":true,"deliveryProduct_Id":9468093,"deliveryType":1}. The PATCH response carries the computed cart. No login, street address, payment or order submission; the checkout itself was not entered.
anonymousCartQuotes.lineIdentityNote: The cart accepts the listing only by its row id (retailerProductId 9469068). Supplying the branchProductId instead marks the line inactive, so that value is never used for a quote.
anonymousCartQuotes.arithmetic: Each cart total equals item subtotal + the single ₪28 delivery line; no other fee, discount or deposit appeared.

sources.name: Super Haviv (סופר חביב), branch 3507 Petah Tikva

delivery.minimumOrderConflict: The store's published terms text (agreementText in the public config) states a site minimum of ₪200 and a ₪34 delivery fee, and mentions an expired free-delivery-above-₪499 promotion (valid until 31.12.2025). The live branch config and the storefront's own checkout code resolve the minimum as area.deliveryMinimumCost first (₪10 for Petah Tikva), but the two published statements conflict and no cart total could be read to settle it.
delivery.coverage: Petah Tikva area only; the second area is Kiryat Ono / Givat Shmuel. No Tel Aviv–Yafo area is published.

anonymousCartAttempt.cartCreate: A 4-tub line activated in the anonymous cart (item total ₪26.00) when supplied with the row id 20230801.
anonymousCartAttempt.deliveryPatch: PATCH /carts/<id> {"deliveryProduct":true,"deliveryProduct_Id":20722246,"deliveryType":1} returned the store's Radware "Unauthorized Request Blocked" page (HTTP 200 HTML, 3,559 bytes) instead of the computed cart, twice (18:24Z and 18:29Z). No challenge was bypassed and no total is claimed.
anonymousCartAttempt.blocker: The applied-delivery cart total cannot be read from the runner for this store; the adapter is therefore not registered/ranked until a permitted read confirms the minimum and the fee.

sources.note: Retained from docs/evidence/tnuva-cottage-cheese-runner-research-20261015.json: ₪6.10 per tub + ₪29.90 home delivery, ₪300 published minimum; anonymous cart quotes exist but no standalone batch is purchasable.
Retained from docs/evidence/tnuva-cottage-cheese-runner-research-20261015.json: ₪6.70 per tub + ₪35 home delivery, ₪150 published minimum; cart reads remain WAF-challenged.

rankedTotals.note: Totals come from the anonymous cart quotes above; ilsPerKg is the delivered total divided by the ordered grams (rounded).

nextStep: The default Tel Aviv–Yafo locality still has no purchasable exact batch: Tiv Taam (₪300) and Super Yuda (₪150) minimums exceed every batch, and Duchan publishes no Tel Aviv area. Options remain: owner selects another covered city/area, owner allows filling an order to a vendor minimum, or a blocked low-minimum chain becomes reachable without bypassing its protection. The Super Haviv Petah Tikva lead needs a permitted applied-delivery cart read (or an owner-accepted published-rate basis with the ₪200/₪10 conflict disclosed) before it can be ranked.
